tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search the Artyfile catalog of licensable music — real recordings by real orchestras and musicians (never AI-generated). Returns ranked tracks with prices; each result id is the productId create_checkout accepts. Results with licenseScope "master_only" are Cover Editions with NO sync licence — do no

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Full details for one track by productId or slug: metadata, prices, licence scope, preview URL, human product page.

tools.name: get_license_terms
tools.description: Machine-readable summary of the Artyfile licence tiers: Basic (€29.90 one-time, worldwide perpetual sync licence) and Limited Edition (€69.90 per 1% numbered master share incl. revenue participation). Includes the Cover-Edition (master_only) restrictions and links to the binding Terms & Conditions.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a checkout for one track. Returns a Stripe hosted-payment URL that the USER must open and approve in a browser (EU PSD2 — payment is never completed by the agent) plus the order publicId for polling. The session and its price reservation expire after 1 hour.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Poll an order by publicId. Once status is "paid" the payload carries downloadUrl (44.1 kHz WAV), invoiceUrl and certificateUrl (PDFs). Poll roughly every 15 seconds; a pending order older than 1 hour has expired.

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: Download + document URLs for a PAID order: the WAV download (link re-issuable anytime, no cookies needed), the PDF invoice and the PDF licence/ownership certificate.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_download_link" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Download + document URLs for a PAID order: the WAV download (link re-issuable anytime, no cookies needed), the PDF invoice and the PDF licence/ownership certifi…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_track, create_checkout, get_download_link · Private data: get_download_link · Public sink: get_license_terms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_track, create_checkout, get_download_link · Private data: get_download_link · Public sink: get_license_terms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
